Yeah, and many think that the protagonist is gonna get angry enough to completely de-associate himself with the female lead, something that is unfathomable. There are many reasons for this. Firstly, the main reason I see is people popularizing the fact that the female lead is gonna tell the victim the truth, which quite frankly, she deserves to know. I'm sorry, but the protagonist is an idiot if he feels betrayed by this. The victim is a victim, and keeping her in the dark is lying to her, and at that point, you are being selfish. The antagonist was cheating on her, had a sextape of her, which consensual or not, she's still a minor. Not only this, but as we saw at the end of the sports festival, she's been trying to get in touch with him. Now, the antagonist has ignored her, but what if he didn't? A woman going back to toxic relationships because they're ignorant as to the levels of abuse happens more often than you'd think. This is something that needs to be quashed in its entirety. Nevertheless, I've seen comment after comment of people thinking that this is a terrible avenue and even some who thought that the female lead was gonna go public with the information. 

Secondly, the student council practically begged people to read that file, this is seriously important. It was on display, for everyone in the world to see, and since anyone can walk into the council room because the door is always unlocked, anyone could have read the file. The council president did just that, and thought it was best that the female lead read it. She also didn't want any bad blood in the council, as they all thought that info should be public aside from the protagonist. The vice president even stated that she would have leaked it if the council president hadn't, and if there's one thing that the protagonist has shown in his character arc, it's that he trusts her judgement wholeheartedly. Thirdly, the matter of the protagonist losing interest in the female lead and turning towards another girl, as many have stated, is laughable at best. I've seen the very same people state that the protagonist was gonna do the same when he rejected the female lead's consolation sex, or more recently, when they thought the date had gone badly. This turned out to be false, and yet here we are again, thinking that his love for her is more frail than it is.

What's ironic about this is that the very same people who think the protagonist's wish to keep the matter secret is justified and that should be respected, are those who think that the protagonist is wrong when it comes to his feelings with the female lead. He is simply mistaken, his love is just a crush, built on putting someone on a pedestal. A pedestal that no longer exists as they've gotten much closer. Now this is contradictory, because you can't just pick and choose on something like this. That support should be unconditional, surely. The protagonist is not interested in the other girl at all right now, so him doing a 180 so fast is frankly really unrealistic and just out of character. The protagonist has worked his ass off to get where he is, it's short-sighted to assume that he will stop after another hurdle when he's overcome so many. If push comes to shove and the protagonist reacts harshly, the vice president will set him straight, as she's done time and time again. That's the reason why I love the protagonist x female lead ship, because the vice president and the protagonist are essentially siblings, it's such a sweet and wholesome relationship.
